broadcast_tensor: broadcast a tensor to specified GPU devices using torch.cuda.comm.broadcast
broadcast_coalesced_tensors: broadcast a sequence of tensors to multiple GPUs with coalescing for efficiency
scatter_tensor: scatter a tensor across multiple GPU devices from a source device
reduce_add_tensors: sum tensors from multiple GPUs into a single result tensor
reduce_add_coalesced_tensors: sum sequences of tensors from multiple GPUs with coalescing to reduce synchronizations
